13 Dec 2023
Claim received after a sideswipe during a lane change; the insured's vehicle was struck on the driver's side by a
vehicle that drifted into the lane, and the claimant reports a concussion from the impact.
1 Jan 2024
Reviewed the driver's policy record and confrimed the driver is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at

17 Jan 2024
Police report and two independent witnesses place the claimant inside the vehicle at the moment of impact,
consistent with the account given at first notice.
8 Feb 2024
Scene photographs and the other driver's statement both describe the collision as reported, with no sign of a different
sequence of events.
12 Mar 2024
Veihcle inspection shows damage along the side panels and mirror that matches the described impact angle and
direction of travel.
25 Mar 2024
Checked vehicle history and prior claim records; no earlier damage to this vehicle is on file, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the policy start.
15 Apr 2024
Claimant's counsel has provided the initial medical records, which describe a concussion with headache and
dizziness, a presentation that is plasuible for a side impact of this kind.
17 Apr 2024

is not expected to affect the current treatment.
24 Apr 2024
Treatment followed a typical course of rest, follow-up visits, and gradual reduction in care as symptoms improved.
15 May 2024
The claimant later provided additional small details about the sequence of the lane change; these fill in gaps and do
not alter the core account given at first notice.
16 May 2024
Updated treatment notes show setady improvement and a tapering of appointments, consistent with the expected
recovery timeline for this injury.
23 May 2024
Claim reviewed against all available evidence; the reported injury, vehicle damage, witness accounts, and coverage
status are consistent, and the file is ready for settlement evaluation.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
